title: Ты or вы
caption:
Ты or вы? Pick the wrong one and you sound rude, or cold.
ты = one person you know well. вы = someone you respect, or any group.
Not sure? Say вы. It is always safe.
Who was the last person you said ты to? Save this and send it to a friend learning Russian.
